authorities.censoring: RIGHT_CENSORED_DATA_BOUNDARY_EXPLICIT — a trade whose frozen 96-bar outcome window is truncated by the dataset partition end is RIGHT_CENSORED_DATA_BOUNDARY: excluded from resolution and from economic metrics under this frozen policy, its entry_id persisted in the censoring list, and counted in population summaries; never imputed, never a loss, never silently dropped
authorities.collision: STOP_FIRST within every bar (frozen V0.3 fail-closed rule)
authorities.entry_authority: D01_FROZEN_CONTROL (V0.3 campaign chain: hourly observation grid, D01 H4 structure direction, location ALIGNED, first aligned MSS/BOS within 16 bars, entry at confirmation close)
authorities.horizon: 96 M15 bars from entry bar close; exit at the last completed M15 bar close
authorities.sl_authority: opposite extreme of the last 12 M15 bars including the entry bar (frozen V0.3)
authorities.target_authority: V0.5 causal natural-target contracts (NT01-NT04 runnable; NT05 fail-closed), registry 8cfa81f9d1c6724c63eeec7aa86201af99a129f3ccf8dd9acdb078c8d1d8e9c9

dataset.overlap_rule: OOS and DEVELOPMENT windows are disjoint half-open intervals; the SEALED_HOLDOUT is never sliced or read by any stage
dataset.warmup_rule: frozen V0.3 campaign semantics: 21-day warm-up INSIDE the evaluated partition; full 96-bar outcome windows required inside the partition

economic_firewall.rule: no NET_R, net expectancy, net PF, economic win rate, economic Sharpe, profitability or EDGE_VERIFIED claim may be produced from this OOS run

frozen_candidate.censoring_policy: RIGHT_CENSORED_DATA_BOUNDARY_EXPLICIT — a trade whose frozen 96-bar outcome window is truncated by the dataset partition end is RIGHT_CENSORED_DATA_BOUNDARY: excluded from resolution and from economic metrics under this frozen policy, its entry_id persisted in the censoring list, and counted in population summaries; never imputed, never a loss, never silently dropped
frozen_candidate.fraction_selection_authority: PREREGISTERED_GRID_MIDPOINT_50_50 — the midpoint of the frozen V0.6 25/50/75 sensitivity grid, fixed by convention BEFORE any OOS data and WITHOUT reference to DEV outcomes (V0.6 rule: 'no percentage is promoted from DEV'); the full-grid DEV sensitivity remains published in the V0.6 artifacts and is restated in the freeze report
frozen_candidate.horizon_exit_price_authority: M15_CLOSE_OF_LAST_COMPLETED_BAR_AT_OR_BEFORE_HORIZON — the close of the 96th M15 bar after the entry bar (the last bar of the frozen V0.3 outcome window); identical to the repository AG_REFERENCE_REPLAY v1.1.0 DATA_END fill (exit_price = last completed bar close)

frozen_controls_phase6.rule: C3_F50_R0 compared ONLY against the preregistered V0.6 focal controls C0_2R and C0_5R on resolved pairs (V0.6 registry semantics); no new policy family, no fraction grid, no target search

metric_definitions.FIRST_OBJECTIVE_REACHED_PCT: traded rows whose first leg exits at FIRST_OBJECTIVE / TRADED_N
metric_definitions.GROSS_STRUCTURAL_R: sum of gross_trade_r over traded (complete termination; NO friction)
metric_definitions.MAX_STRUCTURAL_DRAWDOWN_R: max peak-to-trough decline of cumulative gross R over traded rows ordered by (entry_time, entry_id), running max initialized at 0
metric_definitions.NATURAL_TARGET_P25/MEDIAN/P75_R: quantiles of the first (nearest) causal objective R over entries with a non-empty ladder
metric_definitions.P_SECOND_GIVEN_FIRST: among traded rows with the first objective reached, the fraction whose SECOND distinct ladder level was reached before the SL
metric_definitions.RIGHT_CENSORED_N: windows truncated by the partition boundary (RIGHT_CENSORED_DATA_BOUNDARY)
metric_definitions.RUNNER_EXTENDED_REACH: among traded rows with the first objective reached, the fraction whose runner leg exits at RUNNER_TARGET
metric_definitions.Rk_CAPABILITY: fraction of ALL entries reaching the fixed kR level before the frozen SL inside the 96-bar window (k = 1..5)
metric_definitions.UNRESOLVED_RUNNER_N: traded rows without complete two-leg resolution (must be 0)
metric_definitions.bases: ENTRY_N = all OOS D01 campaign entries; TRADED_N = C3-applicable (first objective exists AND runner objective strictly beyond); capabilities and natural-target quantiles use the FULL entry population

no_retuning: no fraction change (50/50 stays; 25/75 and 75/25 forbidden)
single_attempt: the authorized OOS partition is opened for ONE sealed evaluation (determinism double-pass and independent verifier reconstruction included in the same sealed run); NO SECOND OOS ATTEMPT

thresholds.FINAL_VERDICT_RULE: worst(pooled, sufficient-sample symbol verdicts); a symbol below SYMBOL_MIN_TRADED_N is D_SUBSAMPLED and caps the final verdict at B; D if pooled traded < POOLED_MIN_TRADED_N or >= 2 symbols below SYMBOL_MIN_TRADED_N; E overrides everything on verification failure
thresholds.POOLED_VERDICT_RULE: same rule on pooled values (A also requires pooled mean >= 0.5 * DEV pooled mean)
thresholds.SYMBOL_VERDICT_RULE: C if any gating pp delta < -20pp OR symbol mean <= 0.0; else B if any gating pp delta < -10pp OR symbol mean < 0.5 * DEV symbol mean; else A
VERIFICATION_INVALID_E_CONDITIONS: DEV/OOS window overlap or holdout access
independent reproduction mismatch (population, objectives, outcomes, gross structural R, metrics, or verdict)
